detailed_findings.root_cause_confirmed: Production PDF endpoints returned 500 because fonts 'GPSans*' were loaded from /usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation which does not exist in production container. Font registration silently skipped causing KeyError.
detailed_findings.fix_verified: Fonts now bundled in /app/backend/fonts/*.ttf and pdf_fonts.py resolves bundled dir first. All PDF/Excel endpoints now return 200 with valid files.
